title: Etale multiplicative degree-two cohomology equals Galois cohomology
statement: For every field K, H²_G(Ks^×) [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology] is in bijection with H²(Spec(K)_et,G_m), the cohomological Brauer group [def-br].

proof.text: Choose an algebraically closed geometric point containing Ks. The geometric stalk equivalence identifies abelian etale sheaves over Spec K with discrete continuous absolute-Galois modules. The stalk of G_m is Ks^× with its natural action: etale neighbourhoods see finite separable extensions, even for imperfect K.

Under this exact equivalence, global sections correspond to invariants and injective resolutions are transported to injective resolutions. Therefore all right derived functors of sections agree with derived invariants. Continuous homogeneous cochains compute these derived invariants for discrete modules and profinite G. Take degree two, remove canonical universe lifts of the coefficient group, and forget the group structure to get the desired equivalence. Since G is compact Hausdorff, the compact-open exponential law identifies Mathlib iterated continuous maps with continuous maps on finite powers of G. TopModuleCat homology has underlying algebraic kernel modulo image, so forgetting its topology preserves the cocycle classes.
